title: Procedures related to EAP methods other than EAP-AKA' and EAP-TLS

entities.name: EAP-based primary authentication and key agreement procedure
entities.description: Authentication procedure using EAP methods other than EAP-AKA' and EAP-TLS in SNPN, supporting mutual authentication and EMSK/MSK generation.

entities.name: AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message
entities.description: NAS message containing EAP-request message used in authentication procedure.

entities.name: AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE message
entities.description: NAS message containing EAP-response message sent by UE.

entities.name: AUTHENTICATION REJECT message
entities.description: NAS message that may contain EAP-failure message when authentication fails.

entities.name: EAP message information element
entities.description: IE containing EAP messages (request, response, success, failure) in authentication procedure.

entities.name: ngKSI
entities.description: Next Generation Key Set Identifier used to identify security contexts.

entities.name: ABBA
entities.description: Anti-Bidding-down Between Architectures parameter used in key derivation.

entities.name: Timer T3520
entities.description: Timer started by UE when AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE is sent if UE fails to authenticate network.

entities.name: Timer T3247
entities.description: Timer started when AUTHENTICATION REJECT message is received without integrity protection.

entities.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state
entities.description: 5GMM state entered upon authentication failure or rejection.

entities.name: Partial native 5G NAS security context
entities.description: Security context created in volatile memory identified by ngKSI value, containing KAMF.

entities.name: Authentication failure condition
entities.description: Condition when UE fails to authenticate network or network fails to authenticate UE.

relations.description: AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message contains EAP message IE with EAP-request.
AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE message contains EAP message IE with EAP-response.
When UE fails to authenticate network, UE starts timer T3520.
Upon receiving AUTHENTICATION REQUEST with EAP-request, UE stops timer T3520 if running.
Upon receiving AUTHENTICATION REJECT, UE enters 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state.
Successful EAP authentication establishes partial native 5G NAS security context.
When AUTHENTICATION REJECT is received without integrity protection, UE starts timer T3247.
AUTHENTICATION REJECT message indicates authentication failure condition.
EAP authentication procedure uses ngKSI to identify security contexts.
EAP authentication procedure uses ABBA parameter for key derivation.
